records.prompt: On the Android phone, open the 'Gmail' app.
On the Android phone screen, tap Compose at x=120 y=220.
On the mobile screen, type 'alice@example.com' into the focused recipient field.
On the Android phone screen, type 'Mobile pilot' into the focused subject field.
On the Android phone screen, scroll down to older messages.
On the mobile screen, swipe from x=100 y=700 to x=100 y=300.
Create a Notion page titled 'Mobile pilot' with content 'WebGPU state loop passed'.
Send an email to 'alice@example.com' with subject 'Mobile pilot' and body 'The WebGPU state loop passed'.
On the Android phone screen, navigate back from the compose window.
On the Android phone, open the 'Gmail' app.
